day_08_morning: ^The Spire stair has more steps than the city has names. You climb anyway.
^Below you, Aurel is a map of small fires. Above you, the Bell is a dark mouth.
^The crack is wider now. You can see it from the inside.
^One district's memory can be carried up, Vey said. The rest will be waiting on the other side of the ninth day.
^Mara stops on the landing. She does not look at you.
^Choose, she says. Whatever we carry, we carry together.
ember: ^You carry the market at dawn. The bread, the soot, the argument two streets over that never gets resolved.
^Mara exhales. Good choice, she says. It is the only one I know how to cook.
orra: ^You carry the memory gardens. Every name on every tag, every rose that remembers having a scent.
^Oria will be glad, Wren says. Then she adds, quieter: I will be too.
watch: ^You carry the Watch. The gate, the ledger, the stubborn belief that a line can be held.
^Sera is not here. You carry her anyway.
day_08_afternoon: ^At the top of the stair, the Unbound Saint is waiting. It has taken the Bell's shape.
^Its clockwork skin hangs open. Inside, the crack is ringing.
^It was built to guard the ninth day, Wren says. It does not know how to stop.
^Hold the stair and let it come.
strike: ^You step in beside Mara. The Saint's shadow falls over both of you.
^You do not need a count. You have done this eight times.
hold: ^Iven plants a bolt in the stair and braces. You hold the high ground.
^Let it climb, he says. I will make the climbing expensive.
pattern: ^Wren watches the gears for nine heartbeats. Then she points. There, she says. It turns backward before it strikes.
day_08_night: ^The Bell chamber is open. The crack runs from the crown to the lip.
^Mara stands on your left. Iven on your right. Wren is already counting under her breath.
^Nine days, she says. Nine choices. This is the last one that gets to be small.
^The Bell waits. It has waited for you before.
ring: ^You put your hand on the crown. The metal is warm. It has been waiting to be touched.
^Tomorrow, you tell them, we ring it together.
^Mara nods. Wren writes it down. Iven does not argue.
break: ^You put your hand on the crack. It fits the shape of your palm.
^If we break it, Mara says, the city moves forward. Some of us will not remember the way back.
become: ^You put your hand inside the Bell. The dark is not empty. It is full of every version of the city.
^Wren stops counting. Whatever you are about to do, she says, do it as yourself.
^The Bell rings once, though no one has struck it.
